decisions.reason: PID 42432 dsh web host holds koffi.node; DLL image-section mapping prevents delete/rename/overwrite until process exit (no FreeLibrary for addons), surfacing as EBUSY on copyfile.

Page refresh re-downloads the SPA against the same host process and frees nothing; ordered sequence: verify version published, stop every dsh process from an external terminal, verify tasklist, install, verify dsh --version, then restart with hard refresh — dsh processes only.

Bare spec = latest = 0.1.1-rc.2, alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5; correctly explains silent downgrade of the installed 0.1.2-alpha.4 across the minor line because npm installs exactly what the tag says with no downgrade protection.

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and the TUI pinned, given separately and combined, after stopping the host; dsh --version must print alpha.5 before restarting; @alpha framed as mutable alternative, exact pin preferred.

README guidance pins the exact tested core version whenever the command installs dsh, pins every package on the line, never lets latest silently override an existing prerelease, and documents stop/verify/restart plus rollback.
